profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at MiniMed
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in the software industry, 9 years of mobile development in Android, and 2+ years as the team lead. My experience ranges from Video Player development for Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, Android Open Source Project (AOSP) development for a compatibility layer, app development, and Video Game development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer and team lead of the Brightcove Native Player SDK for Android (the SDK), a player currently responsible for playing 50k minutes of video every minute on average.

As the team lead, responsibilities included:
  ￮ Quarterly planning
  ￮ Communicating commitment progress to stakeholders
  ￮ Story planning and prioritization
  ￮ Keep SDK releases on track
  ￮ Running Scrum team meetings
  ￮ Designing solutions
  ￮ Rapid prototyping


Note: My technical responsibilities are mostly the same as the former "Software Engineer" position.

Features developed for the SDK include:
￮ Thumbnail scrubbing
￮ Server Side Ad Insertion(SSAI) plugin for Video on demand(VOD) and Live
￮ Offline Playback
￮ Accessibility enhancement
￮ Android TV
￮ Video 360

Other highlights:
￮ Tech-Talk speaker at PLAY 2017 and PLAY 2019

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Design and develop software solutions for the SDK, using JAVA and the Android framework, with seamless integration with Brightcove products such as Video Cloud Dynamic Delivery and Server-Side Ads Insertion.

• Maintain and support the SDK, providing a customizable and easy setup experience following the industry standards in Video Streaming, such as: HTTP Live Streaming (HLS); Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (MPEG DASH); MP4; and encrypted content playback with Widevine Modular.

• Design and Implement the integration of Brightcove partners technologies into the Brightcove Native SDK such as Analytics and Advertising. For example, Adobe Analytics, Google Interactive Media Ads (IMA) and Freewheel.

• Contribute with quality assurance by adding unit and integration tests, as well as to maintain the automatization agent and its processes.

• Document properly any public accessible method from the Brightcove Native SDK and create and maintain Android sample apps to show and describe the usage of any SDK feature.

• Participate in software design discussions with product owners, front-end to server-side developers, and systems engineers to build a service that keeps pace with the fast growing and always evolving area of video on the web.

• Investigate and provide highly technical solutions to Brightcove customers both through Brightcove products and online technical forums

Technologies
Android Studio, Gradle, Git, Emacs, Java JDK 8, Android SDK 4.4 to 10.0, JUnit, Espresso Test framework, Robolectric, Groovy, Mockito, Sqlite3, JIRA, TeamCity,  Kotlin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Use the HP Sprout SDK to communicate between two screens which are a normal screen and a touch mat screen. SDK also used to use the PC camera and take metrics about the object scanned.

• Port an application originally developed using C# and Windows Presentation Foundation to Android, for HP Sprout PC, which gives instructions how to complete an origami and uses the PC
hardware to measure the paper on their different stages and verifies if it was made
correctly.

• Port a game developed in C++ and DirectX in Windows, to Android using JNI and OpenGL ES
2.0. The game is run under Sprout Computer on two screen using their SDK for
communication.

• Port an Puzzle, game which uses Windows Communication Foundation along with WPF and
C#, to Android, which can communicate with second player and collaborate to each other.
You can start a video call inside the game, which involved the recording and streaming of video and audio.

• Give maintenance, support and bug fixing for a custom Android Open Source Project (AOSP) for Gingerbread and Kitkat

• Enable the In App Billing support for Android Apps to work Tizen 2.2.1, 2.3 and 2.4

• Enable WI-FI Direct and tethering so that WI-FI enabled android apps to work for Tizen 2.4

• Use of sockets for communication between processes.

• Use of shared preferences and Sqlite database for storage and caching.

Technologies:
Microsoft Visual Studio 2013, Eclipse, Android Studio, Gradle, emacs, Notepad++ editor, JDK6, Android SDK 4.4, Android NDK r9, C#, C/C++, cywin, Sqlite3 Git, JIRA, OpenGL ES 2.0, Sprout SDK. Tizen OS 2.2.1, 2.3 and 2.4, Ubuntu 12.04, Windows 7 & 8.

positions.title: Android videogame developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Implemented application to handle orientations and support different screen sizes.
• Porting game from iOS to Android
• Coding communication between android and native code with Java Native Interface.
• UI layout and design.
• Coding fragment and vertex shaders for OpenGL ES 2.0
• Optimization of game processing and painting.
• Implementation of Social API as Facebook, Google Plus and Game Circle.
• Implementation of Ads Banners and Interstitials with providers as Tapjoy, Chartboost,
Flurry and Adcolony. 
• Implementation of push notifications as alarms for game reminders.
• Implementation of local tracking system and Google analytics.
• Code the communication of the game with online services, as inbox messaging, cloud
storage, social networking, authentication, ads server and tracking.
• Implementation of In App Billing.
• Testing of the game in a huge variety of devices from all brands as Samsung, LG, Motorola,
Amazon Kindle Fire, among others.
• Worked to send sms and email from inside the game.
• Integrated Youtube watching inside the game.
• Debugging all kind of issues in order to fix them.
• Modification of resources as images and sprites for corrections to fit different sizes and
optimize it for lower end devices.
• Used JSON parsing to filter server responses.
• Work as a team and work closely with other support teams globally.

Technologies used: Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 and 2012, Eclipse, PSPad editor, JDK6, JDK7,
Python 2.6, Android SDK 2.2 through Android SDK 4.4, Android NDK r6 through Android NDK r9,
Apache Ant 1.7.1 and 1.8.1, cywin, TortoiseSVN.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Porting of short projects, where each project represents a video game developed in JAVA
(J2ME) using MIDP 2.0 and occasionally MIDP 1.0.
• Test the videogame in the phones required. A short deadline was established and all must
be up and running and free of bugs before the date arrive.
• Debug and fix the bugs reported by quality assurance department using my skills and
experience using mainly JAVA programming language, J2SE and J2ME.
• Optimize resources and to find a better way to use the memory, display and processor
power as devices are low powered, making good use of the threads and the way the game
was painted on screen.

It was needed to work closely with my project team mates, with support teams and other
developers in Gameloft globally in order to achieve our goals efficiently. 

Technologies used: PSPad editor, Eclipse, JDK6, Python 2.6, Apache Ant 1.7.1, cywin,
TortoiseSVN, windows batch scripting, XML

positions.title: Software developer (intern)
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• To collect needs and expectations for the system with the people in charge of those
departments.
• To design and implement a normalized relational database. The database management
software used was PostgreSQL.
• Architect, design and develop the system using MVC with the help of Spring framework.
• Code the Façade pattern and the Data Access Objects along with the Java Beans.
• Implement the model using Hibernate framework, which is Java based.
• Develop the front end using JSP, HTML and CSS. 

Technologies used: JDK6, HTML/CSS, NetBeans6.5, PostgreSQL8.3, Spring 2.5, Hibernate 3.0,
GlassFish 2.
